software: Python 3.12.14; standard-library exact Fraction and sparse Q[n] exterior arithmetic

mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact 48-by-48 contraction detector for the product of two genus-three Abel-orbit ideals has determinant n^42. One-factor detectors have determinant -n^3; ordered factorwise imbalance gives the matching rank upper bound 48.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q[n], n an indeterminate; no floating point or sampled orbit order
mathematics.conventions: Per-factor exterior order u0,u1,u2,w0,w1,w2; first factor before second; left interior at wi includes its sign past u factors; f_n=1-n*theta^2/2+n*theta^3/3.

bounds.geometric_orbit_order: n=d+1 with d=176400*d0, d0 a positive integer

non_claims: Does not identify actual derived Ext groups or prove the Hochschild--Atiyah identity.
Does not construct geometric cycles, prove analytic effectivity, or establish period spread by computation.
Does not instantiate the canonical Betti map in Lean.

checks: Computed actual contractions in the twelve-generator exterior algebra.
Compared all 2304 entries of the selected matrix with the independent three-block Kronecker construction.
Verified both six-dimensional one-factor diagonal detectors, all target c2 basis terms, and every off-diagonal zero.
Verified product determinant exactly n^42 and all 48 nonzero diagonal monomials.
result: Exact symbolic determinant n^42; an explicit diagonal right inverse exists over Q[n,n^-1]. Geometric specialization has n>0. No finite list of n values is substituted for a universal identity.
residual_risks: Custom exterior and polynomial implementation; cross-checked against independent factorwise Kronecker multiplication and the manuscript basis derivation.
The rank upper bound and identification with actual Hodge/Ext maps are separate written mathematical arguments.
Version 1 has legacy machine-provenance limitations; argv, before/after input hash, wall timeout and actual interpreter were explicitly recorded by this host wrapper.
